content: Phased UI migrations on live products avoid confusing half-migrated states via: strangler-pattern slice-by-slice replacement instead of a big-bang cutover; feature flags/progressive rollout gating who sees new vs old nav; a stable shell/routing layer that keeps navigation, auth, and analytics continuous while individual views swap underneath; and fallback/rollback paths available during cutover so a broken migrated view doesn't block daily use.
